ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in the United States
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud across the United States, including the alleged schemes in Minnesota and Ohio
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting on child care fraud
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in the United States?
Who is behind the alleged schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a widespread issue and hold those responsible accountable. Further investigation is needed to determine the scope of the problem and identify key players.
